title: Upgrade-Loyalty Discount for Paloma Business Accounts
content:
Whole months from KYB approval to the date the committed plan took effect decide the upgrade-loyalty discount, a percentage, on the early termination charge of a Paloma Business downgrade: 12 or more whole months earn an upgrade-loyalty discount of 10 percent; 1 to 11 whole months earn 5 percent; fewer than 1 whole month, including an account on the committed plan since approval, earns none.

The upgrade-loyalty discount is a percentage of the gross termination charge, the months charged multiplied by the month price. It is added to any other percentage discount on that gross charge into one percentage, and the gross termination charge is reduced once by that combined percentage and rounded half up to the cent.

### Questions answered

**Which two dates decide the discount?** The KYB approval date of the account and the date the committed plan took effect, the plan effective date shown on the account.

**An account was approved on Paloma Business Scale and has stayed on it since. What discount does it earn?** None: the plan took effect on the approval date, fewer than 1 whole month after it.

**An account was approved on 5 March and moved up to Paloma Business Scale on 20 May of the same year.** 2 whole months: 5 percent.

**An account was approved on 5 March and moved up to Paloma Business Enterprise on 5 March of the following year.** 12 whole months: 10 percent.

**An account was approved on 5 March and moved up on 4 April.** Fewer than 1 whole month: none.

### Ladder

| Whole months from KYB approval to the date the committed plan took effect | Upgrade-loyalty discount |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | 10 percent |
| 1 to 11 | 5 percent |
| Fewer than 1 | None |
